title: Prusa Connect First Layer Retry Trend
app: Bambu Lab printers, Prusa Connect, OctoPrint, Moonraker, LaserWeb, CNC.js, drybox sensors, and workshop telemetry via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prusaconnect:printer event=first_layer
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count(eval(result="retry")) as retries, count as attempts by printer _time
| eval retry_pct=round(100*retries/attempts,1)
| where attempts>=5 AND retry_pct>10
| sort - retry_pct
description: Uses Prusa first-layer events telemetry to monitor monthly first-layer retry rate per printer in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for build-surface or calibration problems that are growing, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Prusa first-layer events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Monthly printer chart of first-layer retry percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It lists monthly first-layer retry rate per printer so you can spot build-surface or calibration problems that are growing before it becomes annoying.
